store.description: Pocket field tool for FPV pilots. Checklists: bench, field, post-flight and crash inspection. Battery: charger settings for LiPo / LiHV / Li-ion (end voltage, current at 0.5-2C), per-cell voltage check with charge estimate and land/storage status, voltage reference. Channels: 5.8 GHz spectrum of analog bands, DJI V1/Avatar, O3, O4 and HDZero with overlap view, group presets for 2-6 pilots and IMD check. Props: 31 mm to 20 inch in millimetres with typical motor, KV and battery. Battery log: pack IDs matching your labels, cycle counter and condition. Offline, keyboard only, English and Ukrainian. Reference data from Oscar Liang (oscarliang.com) and the DJI O4 manual.
